text:
sara_support: @here customers reporting increased 5xx and timeouts for hosted inference since ~09:12 UTC. Gateway 502/504 spike and we see a matching increase in cache-layer errors (prefix K/V). Any ideas?

ken_infra: which cache? memcached or redis? can you paste the dashboard link and a sample request id?

sara_support: looks like prefix cache (memcached in front of model prefetch). dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/abc123
sample req id: req_0a1b2c3d — logs: 
```
2026-03-16T09:11:58Z ERROR prefix-cache shard-7: conn-refused to 10.2.7.23:11211
2026-03-16T09:12:01Z WARN prefetch: backend fetch fallback trigger for model-redwood-v2 (timeout)
2026-03-16T09:12:03Z ERROR gateway: upstream 504 from prefix-cache
```

nate_eng: I see a heartbeat spike from memcached cluster around 09:10-09:14 and a lot of retransmits. Could be network flapping or auth handshake failures. Any recent deploys to infra or cache config?

lucy_prod: We rotated the KMS key yesterday for a few customers but that shouldn't affect memcached auth. No infra deploys in the last 2 hours except a small rollout of prefetch tuning at 08:45.

marc_sre: ops-bot, do we have alerts on memcached connect errors or sockets exhaustion?

ops-bot: Alert: memcached-shard-7 connection-error-rate > 10/s since 2026-03-16T09:11:40Z. Autoscale not triggered (min-pool).

ken_infra: Can someone run a quick tcpdump on shard-7 host and check if there are repeated RSTs? Also check memcached logs for auth failures: 
`journalctl -u memcached -n 200`

nate_eng: Reproduced locally with a short load test hitting prefix cache: when memcached returns ECONNRESET the gateway retries and then times out causing 504 -> client 5xx. We should enable read-through fallback to origin for affected shards immediately.

sara_support: For customers complaining, we can advise a short-term workaround: add client-side retry/backoff and set `cache_fallback: origin` to bypass prefix cache. But need an infra action to fix the cluster.

ken_infra: I can try recycling memcached on shard-7 and draining traffic. Planning: mark shard-7 readonly, restart memcachedd on 10.2.7.23, then promote. Will take ~6m.

deploy-bot: Starting rolling restart of memcached cluster shard-7 (10.2.7.23) at 2026-03-16T09:20:12Z.

marc_sre: After restart I still see a short auth hiccup: memcached log shows `ERROR auth: SASL handshake failed - invalid-credentials` around 09:18. That suggests a credential rotation or mis-propagated secret to that host.

lucy_prod: Hmm — earlier KMS rotation wrote new secrets to secret-store. Looks like shard-7 didn't pick up the new secret due to agent restart ordering. Confirming.

nate_eng: OK root cause likely: secret rotation (KMS) + memcached agent restart lag -> one shard had stale SASL creds causing repeated auth failures and connection resets -> prefetch pipeline dropped to origin fallback -> gateway timed out -> 504/502 observed by clients.

sara_support: Good find. Action items: (1) Re-deploy secret-agent to shard-7 to pick up correct creds, (2) drain/restart memcached to clear stale connections, (3) enable temporary per-shard origin fallback for requests to reduce client impact, (4) notify affected customers with repro steps.

ken_infra: Completed re-deploy of secret-agent and restarted memcachedd on shard-7 at 09:26. Connections healthy now, auth errors gone from logs.

ops-bot: Alert cleared: memcached-shard-7 connection-error-rate back to baseline at 2026-03-16T09:29:03Z.

sara_support: Customers reporting reduced errors. One asked for root cause and mitigation steps. I'll draft a short blurb: 
- Issue: memcached shard failed to pick up rotated SASL credentials causing auth failures and connection resets; gateway observed upstream 504s
- Impact: elevated 5xx/timeouts for hosted inference (prefetch/cache layer) 09:11–09:29 UTC
- Mitigation: restarted secret-agent + memcached on affected host; temporary fallback to origin enabled; recommend client retry/backoff and optional cache_fallback flag

lucy_prod: We'll follow up with a fix to secret rollout ordering (agent should pick new creds before traffic allowed). Also add a health-check gating during secret rotations.

marc_sre: Filing incident ticket INC-2026-032: include timeline, logs, dashboard links, and postmortem owner. Assign to lucy_prod for remediation.

sara_support: Thanks — closing thread once customers confirm. :white_check_mark:

nate_eng: Postmortem note: add a perf test that simulates secret rotation with rolling restarts to catch this ordering problem.

sara_support: Customer follow-up sent at 09:40 UTC; they acknowledged restored service. I'll leave the incident open until the remediation PR lands.

lucy_prod: Working on PR for gating and will link it to the incident.

sara_support: Thanks all.
